claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: CITCO is a weak, poorly soluble CAR agonist that at 2.5 uM is unlikely to kill cells through CAR biology; any modest antiproliferative effect would most plausibly reflect nonspecific physicochemical/lysosomal stress rather than a targeted cytotoxic mechanism.
